title: Cutting & Shaping
welcome_lead: Hacksaws, files and chisels — taking material away.
meta_desc: KS3 D&T: saws, files, chisels, safe use.
final_note: Choose the right cutting tool for the material.

concepts.def: Saw with replaceable blade for metal.
Stiff straight saw for wood joints.
Sharp blade tapped to cut wood.

walkthroughs.body_html: For metal, use a hacksaw. For straight wood cuts in joinery, use a tenon saw. For thin coping cuts, a coping saw. Wrong saw = bad cut.
Once cut, smooth metal edges with a file — push and lift on the return. For wood, use a chisel tapped with a mallet — keep both hands behind the cutting edge.
Always: wear goggles, tie back hair, no loose clothing, clamp work in a vice, walk don't run. If you don't know how to use it, ask first.
